The '''B-R6 Prototype Droid''' was a tripedal prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] designed in the Research and Development sector of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It was armed with two powerful [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] on its arms. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was destroyed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces that invaded the factory.

==Behind the scenes==
The B-R6 Prototype Droid appears as an enemy in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it can be found in the Research and Development area of the Okara Droid Factory&mdash;a Heroic area in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
